video.title: LA Clippers 2026/27 Season Preview: No Kawhi, Bright Future?

summary: Josh Lloyd and Darian Vizer of Locked On Clippers preview the 2026/27 Clippers after a reset. They assume the Kawhi Leonard trade goes through, and Harden and Zubac are already gone. The projected starters are Darius Garland, Brandon Ingram, Rui Hachimura, Brook Lopez and Kris Dunn. Darian expects Dunn to start over the No. 5 pick Keaton Wagler because the team needs a plus defender. Yanic Konan Niederhauser is recovering from a broken foot and may not return until around Christmas or 2027. The Clippers don't control their own picks, so they will try to stay competitive instead of tanking. Darian predicts 42-40, while Josh puts the range at 25 to 45 wins, with health of Garland and Ingram as the key.

rules.text: A team that does not own its own draft picks has no reason to tank. It will try to stay competitive, which can limit development minutes for young players.
